description.value: We conducted whole-brain voxel-based morphometric comparison of structural MR images of 22 patients (14-18 years) with severe substance and conduct problems and 21 controls of similar age.

spans.text: We conducted whole-brain voxel-based morphometric comparison of structural MR images of 22 patients (14-18 years) with severe substance and conduct problems and 21 controls of similar age using statistical parametric mapping (SPM) and voxel-based morphometric (VBM8) toolbox.

value: Female adolescents with severe substance and conduct problems will show significantly less gray matter volume in frontal regions critical to inhibition (i.e. dorsolateral prefrontal cortex and ventrolateral prefrontal cortex), conflict processing (i.e., anterior cingulate), valuation of expected outcomes (i.e. medial orbitofrontal cortex) and the dopamine reward system (i.e. striatum).

description.value: Structural images were converted, segmented into gray matter, white matter, and cerebrospinal fluid, registered using DARTEL, modulated, and smoothed.

Finally, the images were registered using the final DARTEL templates to provide modulated GM and WM.
The modulated GM images were smoothed with a 8mm full-width half maximum Gaussian filter.
